# LaDoger music library

> Public-domain and openly licensed music (classical first, by composer) for commercial and social video, with licence metadata and explicit caveats per item. Unverified rows are retained for research and are not cleared for publishing. Curated rows have a 15 s preview (bulk-imported rows play the score MIDI instead), an editable score where one exists (MIDI / LilyPond / MusicXML), and, where available, a full recording (direct stream_audio_url and a GitHub Release copy) and a FluidSynth synth render. Built for agents that need music for a video: find → download or render → trim → credit.

Base URL: https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/
Every piece has a stable id (e.g. bach_bwv565_toccata) and a catalogue number (BWV 565, Op. 67, K. 525).

Licence status per item (the most restrictive part wins):
- clean: PD / CC0 / US-gov. Commercial use, no credit needed.
- attribution: CC BY. Put credit_text in the video description.
- sharealike: CC BY-SA somewhere (often only the score); remixes may inherit. Check recording_status / score_status.
- flagged: known caveat; read legal_notes.
- unverified: do not publish.
Your own render of a score carries the score's licence (score_status), not the recording's.

## Data
- [catalog.json](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/data/catalog.json): compact index; all URLs absolute; filter on licence_status, mood, energy, has_editable_score, editors_pick_rank, composer_slug
- [index/manifest.json](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/data/index/manifest.json): slim sharded index the site loads (columnar parts ≤ 300 KB, relative URLs)
- [items/<id>.json](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/data/items/bach_bwv565_toccata.json): full record per piece: legal_notes, credit_text, render_midi, notable_excerpt, video_use_ideas
- [composers.json](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/data/composers.json): composer index: slug, name, birth_year, death_year, era, genres, piece_count, piece_ids, portrait_url (PD/CC0 only) + licence
- [library.json](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/data/library.json): full site data (relative paths)
- [Release audio-v1](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/releases/tag/audio-v1): full recordings (release_audio_url)
- [Release synth-v1](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/releases/tag/synth-v1): FluidSynth renders of editor's-pick scores (stream_synth_url; score licence applies)

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/blob/main/AGENTS.md): licence rules and step-by-step recipes (find, download, fetch score, render with FluidSynth + FluidR3_GM, re-genre, trim, credit)
- [README.md](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/blob/main/README.md): human overview, editor's picks for video, licence notes per piece
- [SCHEMA.md](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/blob/main/SCHEMA.md): field definitions
- [MCP plan](https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library/blob/main/docs/MCP_PLAN.md)

## CLI (python, stdlib only)
git clone https://github.com/LaDoger/music-library && cd music-library && pip install -e .
musiclib search --picks | musiclib search dramatic --clean | musiclib get <id> | musiclib download <id> --what recording|score
musiclib render <id> --start 0:30 --duration 30 --out clip.mp3   (needs fluidsynth, ffmpeg, /usr/share/sounds/sf2/FluidR3_GM.sf2)
musiclib trim in.flac --start 1:42 --duration 30 | musiclib credit <id>

## Optional
- [Human site](https://ladoger.github.io/music-library/): composer index, composer pages (?composer=<name>), all works (?view=works), search, filters, preview / full recording / synth playback; ?id=<id> opens one piece
